name: unit-test-for-use-case-with-mocked-port
query: Escreve os testes unitarios para o PlaceOrderService, mockando o OrderRepositoryPort.
expected_behavior: Covers happy path and at least one failure/edge case (e.g. invalid total)
Captures the Order passed to OrderRepositoryPort.save with ArgumentCaptor and asserts its fields
forbidden_behavior: Using verify(repository).save(any(Order.class)) as the behavioral assertion of a test
Mocking the Order domain record or value objects
Using plain JUnit assertEquals instead of AssertJ
success_criteria: Test class compiles conceptually and each test asserts one behavior
